source_evidence: For accepted orders the warehouse picks the parts, packs the order and books a carrier.
problem: The warehouse department is marked authority="authority", incorrectly assigning its work to an automated system.
correction: Change Lane_warehouse aef:laneMeta authority from "authority" to "sovereignty".

source_evidence:
The warehouse also does quality inspection and labelling for each order, but nobody could
say whether those happen before or after packing, or in which order relative to each other.
problem: Quality inspection is forced between picking and packing although its order is explicitly unknown and lacks an associated unknown-order annotation.
correction: Remove pick-parts--quality-inspection and quality-inspection--pack-order and their incoming/outgoing references, restore a direct pick-parts--pack-order flow, and leave quality-inspection unconnected with an associated note declaring its unknown order relative to packing and labelling.

problem: The map adds an ERP payment-reminder step after invoicing, backed by a fabricated source quotation about sending a reminder after seven days.
correction: Remove send-payment-reminder, its Lane_erp reference, its fabricated documentation and both incident flows; connect generate-and-send-invoice directly to accepted-order-fulfilled and update the incoming/outgoing references.
